text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян runs well in the Aoi Stakes,
and her
cuteness is praised across social
media. As such,
she's in a good mood.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
On the way home, we run into Eishin
Flash, who
debuted around the same
time as Каррен Тян.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш is doing some last-minute

preparations before the Japanese Derby

tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Impressed by Эйсин Флэш's spirit, Curren
Chan
asks to go watch the Japanese
Derby.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
